recipes.title: Old Fashioned
recipes.instructions:
1. Place the sugar cube in a rocks glass and saturate with bitters.
2. Add a splash of water and muddle until dissolved.
3. Fill the glass with a large ice cube, then pour in the whiskey.
4. Stir gently for 20-30 seconds to chill and dilute.
5. Express an orange peel over the top and drop it in, then garnish with a cherry.
Garnish: Orange peel & a cocktail cherry

recipes.title: Mint Julep
recipes.instructions:
1. Gently muddle mint leaves with simple syrup in a julep cup or rocks glass.
2. Pack the cup tightly with crushed ice.

4. Top with more crushed ice and a generous bouquet of mint.
Garnish: Large mint bouquet & powdered sugar

recipes.title: Sazerac
recipes.instructions:
1. Chill a rocks glass, then rinse it with absinthe and discard the excess.
2. In a separate mixing glass, muddle the sugar cube with bitters.
3. Add rye and ice, then stir until chilled.
4. Strain into the absinthe-rinsed glass and express lemon peel over the top.
Garnish: Lemon peel (expressed, not dropped)
